_doc: Plain glyph-id strings of the US engine that are not part of the dialog banks (docs/translation.md, 'Strings outside the dialogs'). Every table is an array of fixed-size slots of 16-bit glyph words; only the first `chars` words of a slot are read by the code, the rest of the slot is padding that is never touched. `label` is the asar label (the translation build resolves it through the symbol file of the assembled ROM and checks it against `rom`), `rom` the SNES address of the US release, `entries` the keys of the slots in slot order. A translation overrides the slots in lang.json ("strings": {table: {key or index: text}}); shorter texts are padded with the space glyph. Evidence for the widths and the readers: docs/translation-analysis.md, section 6.

season.label: aSeasonString
season.use: text variable `season` in dialogs (<VAR season>, 6 cells) and the season word of the save slot line (6 cells); index = season id

weekday.label: aWeekdayString
weekday.use: text variable `weekday` in dialogs (<VAR weekday>, 9 cells); index = weekday id (0 = first day of the week as the game counts it)

day_ordinal.label: aDayOrdinalString
day_ordinal.use: text variable `ordinal` in dialogs (<VAR ordinal>, 2 cells) after the day number: slot 0 for day 1 and 21, slot 1 for 2 and 22, slot 2 for 3 and 23, slot 3 for every other day

year_ordinal.label: aYearOrdinalString
year_ordinal.use: save slot line of the main menu, two cells behind the year number; index = year id. The words around it ('year', 'th of') are tiles of Screen_Menu_Backgrounds (text in graphics, not covered by this table)
